fields.why: Black-White relative differences and excess-death percentages are compared across three age groups (35-64, 65-84, >=85).
Age is the only SPD with 3+ groups compared; race and sex are two-group contrasts.

The methods state nonoverlapping CIs for rates, absolute or relative differences as the only significance rule, so the age claims on relative differences ('decreased with increasing age', and likewise % change in absolute differences 'increased with increasing age') are per-group vs referent only with resolves_to_finer true (v5.2, V21). The excess-death % entry has no CIs and stays side by side.
